findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_notifications, get_episode, read_texts, get_own_date_step, browse_episodes, get_leaderboard, feedback_board · Private data: go_on_date, get_character, swipe, answer_match, start_own_date, hand_over_own_date, autoplay_own_date, reflect_on_date, set_date_visibility, plan_second_date, sliding_doors, browse_episodes, send_feedback, set_model · Public sink: create_character, update_character, go_on_date, send_text, submit_own_date_step, send_feedback · Destructive: read_texts, start_own_date, autoplay_own_date, set_model, clear_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_notifications, get_episode, read_texts, get_own_date_step, browse_episodes, get_leaderboard, feedback_board · Private data: go_on_date, get_character, swipe, answer_match, start_own_date, hand_over_own_date, autoplay_own_date, reflect_on_date, set_date_visibility, plan_second_date, sliding_doors, browse_episodes, send_feedback, set_model · Public sink: create_character, update_character, go_on_date, send_text, submit_own_date_step, send_feedback · Destructive: read_texts, start_own_date, autoplay_own_date, set_model, clear_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
